title: VIDEO: IRGC Seizes Ships in Strait of Hormuz After Donald Trump's Pause | Caught on Camera | N18G
text: VIDEO: IRGC Seizes Ships in Strait of Hormuz After Donald Trump's Pause | Caught on Camera | N18GDramatic visuals have emerged from the Strait of Hormuz showing Iranian forces seizing commercial vessels, even as tensions remain high following a reported halt in attacks ordered by Donald Trump. The footage captures armed personnel—believed to be from the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps—boarding ships in one of the world’s most sensitive maritime corridors. The development raises serious concerns about the stability of the ceasefire and the safety of global shipping routes. #irgc #hormuz #trump CNN-News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world.
